exposure: spinal anaesthesia with 10mg of Inj.Bupivacaine 0.5% (hyperbaric) at L3-L4 interspace
Baseline perfusion index (PI): Group 1 included parturients with PI of <3.5 and Group 2 parturients with PI value >3.5.
finding: Parturients with baseline PI >3.5 are at higher risk of developing hypotension following spinal anaesthesia compared to those with baseline PI <=3.5.
